title: Tower Semiconductor tops second quarter earnings and revenue expectations
excerpt: Tower Semiconductor (NASDAQ:TSEM) has reported second quarter results above Wall Street expectations, including record revenue and profitability as the chipm...
content_html:
Tower Semiconductor (NASDAQ:TSEM) has reported second quarter results above Wall Street expectations, including record revenue and profitability as the chipmaker continues to benefit from demand across its key business units.

The company reported adjusted earnings per share of $0.88 for the second quarter, above the analyst consensus of $0.67.

Revenue reached a record $460 million, up 24% year over year and ahead of expectations of $437.33 million.

Gross profit rose to a record $138 million, up from $80 million a year earlier, while operating profit excluding non-recurring items more than doubled to $90 million from $40 million.

Net profit excluding non-recurring items reached a record $91 million, up 95% from $47 million in the second quarter of 2025. The result represented a 20% net margin, with basic earnings per share of $0.80 and diluted earnings per share of $0.79.

Tower generated $177 million in cash from operating activities during the quarter and invested $187 million in property and equipment, compared with $123 million and $111 million, respectively, a year earlier.

For the third quarter, Tower guided for record revenue of $520 million, plus or minus 5%. The midpoint represents 31% year-over-year growth and a 13% increase from the second quarter.

The company also raised its 2028 target business model to $3.6 billion in revenue and $1.2 billion in net profit, with Ellwanger noting that the target is fully supported by customer commitments.

Tower Semiconductor CEO Russell Ellwanger highlighted demand momentum across Tower's key business units, alongside expanded manufacturing capacity.

He noted that silicon photonics, or SiPho, revenue reached a $680 million annualized run rate in the second quarter, compared with $180 million a year earlier. Tower expects the SiPho annualized revenue run rate to exceed $1 billion in the fourth quarter.

"Deep strategic customer engagements provide exciting sustainable growth for our customers, and for Tower, thus enabling growing shareholders' value," Ellwanger said.

Tower Semiconductor shares were down more than 2% following the report, likely reflecting profit taking after an almost 100% increase in the company's share price this year.

content_html_zh:
Tower Semiconductor（纳斯达克股票代码：TSEM）公布的第二季度业绩超出了华尔街的预期，包括创纪录的收入和盈利能力，这家芯片制造商继续受益于其关键业务部门的需求。

该公司报告第二季度调整后每股收益为 0.88 美元，高于分析师平均预期的 0.67 美元。

收入达到创纪录的 4.6 亿美元，同比增长 24%，超出预期的 4.3733 亿美元。

毛利润从上年同期的 8000 万美元增至创纪录的 1.38 亿美元，而排除非经常性项目的营业利润则从 4000 万美元增至 9000 万美元，增长了一倍多。

扣除非经常性项目的净利润达到创纪录的 9100 万美元，比 2025 年第二季度的 4700 万美元增长 95%。 结果表明，净利润率为 20%，基本每股收益为 0.80 美元，稀释每股收益为 0.79 美元。

Tower 在本季度的经营活动中产生了 1.77 亿美元的现金，并在财产和设备上投资了 1.87 亿美元，而去年同期分别为 1.23 亿美元和 1.11 亿美元。

Tower 预计第三季度收入将达到创纪录的 5.2 亿美元，上下浮动 5%。 中点代表同比增长 31%，较第二季度增长 13%。

该公司还将其 2028 年业务模式目标提高至 36 亿美元收入和 12 亿美元净利润，Ellwanger 指出该目标得到了客户承诺的充分支持。

Tower Semiconductor 首席执行官 Russell Ellwanger 强调了 Tower 主要业务部门的需求势头以及扩大的制造能力。

他指出，第二季度硅光子学（SiPho）的年化营收达到 6.8 亿美元，而去年同期为 1.8 亿美元。 Tower 预计 SiPho 第四季度的年化收入运行率将超过 10 亿美元。

Ellwanger 表示：“深入的战略客户参与为我们的客户和 Tower 带来了令人兴奋的可持续增长，从而实现了股东价值的不断增长。”

报告发布后，Tower Semiconductor 股价下跌超过 2%，可能反映了今年该公司股价上涨近 100% 后的获利了结。
